sentences.text: The genus Miomancalla contains two known species: M. howardi and M. wetmorei.
The type species Miomancalla wetmorei was described by Howard in 1976.
There are four recorded fossil occurrences of Miomancalla in the Paleobiology Database.
It belongs to the subfamily Mancallinae and is classified within the family Alcidae.
Miomancalla lived from the Tortonian to the Messinian stages, between 11.63 and 5.333 million years ago.
